LOOK: Electric-powered tricycles ferry passengers on the backstreets of Davao City on Friday, Jan. 16.

The City Transport and Traffic Management Office (CTTMO) recently reminded operators and passengers that e-trikes are banned from operating on major roads in the city.

E-trikes are now the most common mode of public transportation in the backstreets of Davao City.
